Keywords: Iron and Golden King Ottokar II
RagShortTexts: The Přemyslid dynasty forged a Central European empire funded by Kutná Hora silver mines.

Variants.Content: The Czech Přemyslid dynasty, bearing the crowned silver double-tailed lion on gules, reached imperial heights under Ottokar II, the 'Iron and Golden King'. His iron denoted disciplined armored cavalry; his gold flowed from the silver veins of Kutná Hora. Ottokar annexed Austria, Styria, and Carinthia, stretching Bohemian power from the Elbe to the Adriatic.
During the Great Interregnum, Ottokar's wealth bribed imperial electors. German princes courted his silver loans while dreading his formidable Slavic dynastic expansion.
Mining engineers and masonry guilds flooded into Bohemia. Royal towns founded under Přemyslid charters sparked explosive urbanization across Central Europe.
